stage2_selected_context_causality.scope: Conditional test of the prospectively selected actual actor and its descendants in one checkpoint context. Does not estimate natural discovery probability, population selection or cross-context generality.
stage2_selected_context_causality.checkpoint: Authenticate complete shared-world state immediately after selected actor birth and before its first action: all competitors, code/private state, food queue, scheduled inputs, source RNG/hash state, time, own ages, material, energy/heat, COPY counter and accumulated costs. Verify original continuation and unchanged restore before contrasts. Qualification repetitions are finite and separately charged.
stage2_selected_context_causality.original: Reuse the original Stage1 continuation only after exact custody and endpoint verification; preserve it independently from derived arms.
stage2_selected_context_causality.control_freeze: Pin exact existing control implementations, same27word/43unit body requirements and all accounting before any contexts are disclosed. All policies may stay. Fixed0 and fixed1 both remain in the roster; no setting is chosen using target outcomes. Control code substitutions are explicitly qualified derived comparisons, not evidence of naturally inherited control genotypes. No new successful learner is supplied.
stage2_selected_context_causality.information_contrast: Predeclare the used-port manipulation at the recognized acquisition-completion event before first warm use. Reset to the fixed neutral port0; nonpredictive value comes from a separately sealed context-independent roster. Sham performs matched handling. Preserve code, food and all other state. Backup history bits remain: this tests causal use of this mediator, not erasure of every information copy.
stage2_selected_context_causality.intervention_costs: Before registration, independently qualify exact state-write counts, storage, time, energy/heat, instruction/age/global scheduling and host costs for every arm. No assumed scalar handling fee or free surgery. If no scientifically authorized method preserves the laws and matches sham, Stage2 remains NO_GO. Existing held intervention contracts do not grant permission.
stage2_selected_context_causality.primary_score: Count living strict descendants of selected actor at absolute global4096. Retain their actual code and full provenance; count dead and absent descendants as zero. Root survival, food, births, timing and heat are declared secondary explanatory endpoints.
stage2_selected_context_causality.declared_contrasts: Intact sham minus used-port reset is the primary mediator contrast. Separately compare intact to the frozen nonlearning control portfolio upper envelope at the same horizon; this is a conservative benchmark, not an oracle policy choosing per context. Equivalent acquired finite-state memory may tie. Nonpredictive and other strategy results remain fully reported.
stage2_selected_context_causality.interpretation: Positive effects require actual acquisition/use, complete paid records, strict positive primary mediator contrast and superiority to the nonlearning benchmark. Ties yield no demonstrated advantage. A complete negative contrast closes this selected-context claim only. Invalid checkpoint, censoring, failed custody or intervention mismatch yields UNKNOWN and retained failure, never a successful score. No claim of broadly evolved intelligence or selection from this one selected context.
